title: Software Developer
text:
Software Developer
We are hiring a Software Developer to build and maintain web applications.

Responsibilities:
- Design, develop and test backend services and REST APIs
- Write clean, maintainable code and unit tests
- Work with SQL databases and optimise queries
- Collaborate with the team using Git and agile practices

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
- Strong knowledge of Python or Java, OOP, data structures and algorithms
- Experience with SQL, REST API development, Git
- Good communication and teamwork skills

Preferred:
- Docker, CI/CD, AWS
- Knowledge of system design
- 0-1 years of experience, freshers welcome

title: Backend Developer
text:
Backend Developer
Build scalable APIs and services for our platform.

Responsibilities:
- Develop REST API services using FastAPI or Flask
- Design database schemas with PostgreSQL and SQLAlchemy
- Containerise services with Docker and deploy to AWS
- Implement authentication, caching and monitoring

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering
- Python, FastAPI, REST API, SQL, PostgreSQL, Git
- Docker and basic understanding of system design
- 1+ years of experience or strong internships/projects
- Problem solving and teamwork

Nice to have:
- Kubernetes, Redis, CI/CD, microservices

title: Data Analyst
text:
Data Analyst
Turn data into insights for business teams.

Responsibilities:
- Clean and analyse datasets using Python, pandas and SQL
- Build dashboards in Power BI or Tableau
- Present findings to stakeholders

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree
- SQL, Python, pandas, Excel, data visualization, statistics
- Power BI or Tableau
- Strong communication and analytical skills

Preferred:
- Machine learning basics, ETL, Git
- 0-2 years of experience

title: Machine Learning Engineer
text:
Machine Learning Engineer
Develop and deploy production machine learning models.

Responsibilities:
- Build, train and evaluate machine learning models
- Perform feature engineering and data processing with pandas and numpy
- Deploy models as APIs with FastAPI and Docker
- Monitor models and automate pipelines (MLOps)

Requirements:
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in AI/ML, Computer Science or related field
- Python, machine learning, scikit-learn, pandas, numpy, SQL
- Deep learning with TensorFlow or PyTorch
- Experience deploying models with Docker
- Problem solving and communication

Preferred:
- XGBoost, MLOps, AWS, CI/CD, NLP
- 1+ years of experience

title: AI / Generative AI Engineer
text:
Generative AI Engineer
Build LLM-powered products using RAG and agents.

Responsibilities:
- Design RAG pipelines with embeddings and a vector database
- Build LLM applications with prompt engineering and LangChain
- Expose AI features through FastAPI REST APIs
- Evaluate and reduce hallucinations

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in AI, Computer Science or related field
- Python, generative AI, LLM, RAG, embeddings, vector database, prompt engineering
- FastAPI, NLP, Git, Docker
- Teamwork and communication

Preferred:
- FAISS, ChromaDB, Hugging Face, AWS, MLOps
- 0-2 years of experience
